data.description: Allah is the one who is worshipped in general, who is the dependent deity and deserving of being the deity and worshipped over all creation. He is endowed with all the qualities of being a deity.

quran.text_arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ
quran.text_translation: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence.

hadith.text_en: Allah has ninety-nine names, one hundred minus one, and whoever believes in their meanings and acts accordingly will enter Paradise.

data.description: He who wills goodness and mercy for all His creatures. His mercy is all-embracing.

quran.text_translation: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.

quran.text_arabic: قُلْ هُوَ الرَّحْمَٰنُ آمَنَّا بِهِ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا
quran.text_translation: Say, 'He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied.'

hadith.text_en: Allah has one hundred parts of mercy, of which He sent down one between the jinn, mankind, the cattle and the insects...

data.description: He who acts with extreme kindness. The Compassionate, The Merciful.

quran.text_translation: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.

hadith.text_en: He who is not merciful to others, will not be treated mercifully.
